description.content:
Zipkin's HTTP API for querying and ingesting distributed tracing data. The API exposes span ingestion and trace, dependency, and autocomplete lookup operations under the `/api/v2` base. Authentication is typically handled by a reverse proxy in front of Zipkin and is not part of the core API.
